summary.text: Ben Moss is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives for District 52, which covers Moore and Richmond counties, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The General Assembly lists his occupation as engineer with CSX.

paragraphs.text: Ben Moss was born in Rockingham, North Carolina, according to Ballotpedia, which lists his profession as engineer.
The General Assembly lists three terms in the House for Moss.
The Republican primary scheduled for March 3, 2026, was canceled.
